name: Social Carousel
tagline: Turn one idea into a swipeable Instagram or LinkedIn carousel with a hook, clear points and a call to action.
youSay: /social-carousel Turn my post about '5 mistakes in portfolio sites' into a LinkedIn carousel for @studio.lou
whatYouGet: 5–10 slides at 1080×1350 (4:5): hook, numbered points with examples, CTA
Consistent palette, fonts, progress dots and handle on every slide
goodFit: Educational tips, listicles and case-study summaries
Creators who post weekly and want a consistent look
youBring: The topic, a draft or bullet points
needs: Chrome or Edge (or Playwright's Chromium) for export
